assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original game title key art, wide landscape 16:9, production illustration without any lettering. Create the world of Ember Vow, a grounded western dark fantasy about the last ember and a broken monastery bell. A monumental cracked bronze bell hangs in a ruined stone arch at the right third; through the arch a misty river valley leads to a distant ruined abbey. In the lower right a small lone adult warrior, brown hair, worn steel shoulder armour over dark leather, carries a large practical two-handed axe lowered away from his clearly visible face. The landscape, weathered masonry, wet stones, grasses and distant bridges are the main subject, the warrior occupies under one quarter of the height. Composition: left 43 percent is calm dark slate architecture, fog and shadow with low visual clutter for existing game logo and menu; concentrate detailed lit architecture and valley in the right two thirds. Rich believable materials, moss in joints, scratched bronze, woven cloth, balanced painterly realism, atmospheric depth, restrained ivory daylight and a few warm embers. Palette slate blue-grey, old iron, weathered stone, dull brass, oxidized teal water, small ember orange. Moody but readable midtones, no crushed blacks. Consistent light from upper left, physically coherent contact shadows, no plastic surfaces or excessive HDR. Refined illustrative game art with controlled brush texture, no existing franchise characters, no imitation of any specific game image, no text, no logos, no UI, no watermark. One finished landscape image.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production texture atlas for a painterly dark fantasy 3D game, top-down orthographic surface scan, square image. Exactly four equally sized square texture tiles in a clean 2 by 2 grid, no borders or gutters. Upper-left: damp olive meadow soil with sparse fine short grass, tiny varied pebbles, small moss patches, NO flowers, NO large objects. Upper-right: worn grey limestone cobbles, irregular rounded rectangular stone sizes, earth-filled joints, subtle moss and dampness. Lower-left: weathered dark brown oak plank surfaces, tactile fibres and occasional tiny iron nail heads, boards straight parallel vertically, no perspective. Lower-right: fractured grey river stone with lichen, subtle seams and mineral flecks. Materials should belong to one original western dark fantasy world. Each quadrant is a seamless repeating top-down flat material texture with evenly distributed detail and approximately equal scale; no directional cast shadows, no vignette, no ambient lighting gradient, no horizon, no plants standing upright, no props, no isolated rocks. Balanced muted natural colour, rich hand-painted realistic microtexture, soft diffuse neutral daylight, no excessively saturated colour or glossy plastic. Seamless texture edges within each tile. No lettering, no labels, no diagrams, no UI, no watermark. One square 2x2 material atlas only.
